system.description:
May they be an appraiser of rare magic items, peddler of illicit substances, or bookkeeper for the court, merchants are masters of exchange.


Iconic Merchants

• Anna, Fire Emblem

• Marco Polo, Venetian merchant

• Torneko Taloon, Dragon Quest IV

• Tressa Colzione, Octopath Traveler


Playing Merchant

The merchant is a low-defense and damage character, who provides high-support through a wider inventory pool and optimizing your

party’s resources. In combat, you should look out for allies in need of assistance and strategize what items to use.


Action: Use

Move: Flexible (skip to Use)


Training: Craft, Influence

features.name: Deep Pockets
features.description: You gain the Deft Hands Perk, and you gain 2 extra Item Slots now and every 3 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Gold Sink
features.description: You can take the Use Action to place non-Relic Items into a container, close it, then spend 1 Luck to choose an Item with a value no more than the original valuables’. The chosen Item replaces the valuables.

features.name: Line Goes Up
features.description:
You gain 1 Luck during a Breather and when you spend a Shift to Craft or Travel.


Further, when you Rest, you gain 1 extra Luck. This extra Luck gained from a Rest increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Diamond Hands
features.description: Items count as Relics with a compatible +1 Bonus Relic Power while you have them Equipped. This Bonus stacks with any other Bonus the Item may have. The Bonus Relic Power is increased by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Opportunist
features.description: Once per Round after another Being uses an Action or Move, you can immediately take the Use Action.

features.name: Top Shelf
features.description: You can use your Gold Sink Ability to pull non-Fabled Relics by spending 1 additional Luck per 250g of the Relic’s value, otherwise obeying all the rules for that Ability.
